background.value: Light background only — the official page explicitly states 'no white backgrounds'.

file_spec.value: Must be an original print taken by a professional photographer; photo-booth, personal, or scanned photographs are rejected. Submitting the full contact sheet is preferable so the passport office can cut it to size themselves.

expression_restriction.value: You should not smile; show your face clearly.

glasses_policy.value: Without glasses (glasses are not permitted); no exception documented in the official source.

face_visibility.value: Show your face; ears and face unobstructed.

headwear_policy.value: Head must be uncovered; the official source does not mention a religious exemption.

expression.en: You should not smile; show your face clearly.
expression.ko: 미소 짓지 말 것; 얼굴이 뚜렷이 보이도록 할 것.
expression.ja: 微笑まないこと。顔がはっきり見えるようにすること。

glasses.en: Without glasses (glasses are not permitted); no exception documented in the official source.
glasses.ko: 안경 착용 불가; 공식 출처에 예외 규정 없음.
glasses.ja: 眼鏡の着用不可。公式情報源に例外の記載はない。

ears.ja: 耳と顔が隠れていないこと。

face_visibility.en: Show your face; ears and face unobstructed.
face_visibility.ko: 얼굴이 뚜렷이 보이도록 할 것; 귀와 얼굴이 가려지지 않아야 함.
face_visibility.ja: 顔がはっきり見えるようにすること。耳と顔が隠れていないこと。

headwear.en: Head must be uncovered; the official source does not mention a religious exemption.
headwear.ko: 머리는 가리지 않아야 함; 공식 출처에는 종교적 예외가 언급되어 있지 않음.
headwear.ja: 頭部を覆わないこと。公式情報源には宗教上の例外について言及がない。

db_conflicts.research_value: Official Monaco government portal states 'Light background only (no white backgrounds)' — the opposite of DB's white.

cross_verification.note_en: monservicepublic.gouv.mc is Monaco's official government public-service portal. Size '4.5 x 3.5 cm' as printed on the source is the same physical dimensions as DB's '3.5 x 4.5cm', just listed width-first; not logged as a conflict. Photos must be produced by a professional photographer — self-service, scanned, or digital photos are explicitly rejected, which is unusual among the countries surveyed in this batch.
